$comment: Phase 11 core-webui auth/session adapter contract. This is the single source of truth the JS adapter (naplatform-adapter.js) and the Python contract test (services/api/tests/test_webui_adapter_contract.py) both read, so the frontend adapter and the FastAPI API can never silently drift. It contains NO secrets — only endpoint shapes.
name: naplatform-core-webui-adapter

endpoints.name: signup
endpoints.notes: New users start pending; admin approval is required before login.

endpoints.name: login
endpoints.notes: Pending/disabled accounts are rejected with 403; the adapter routes those to the approval-waiting UX.

endpoints.name: logout
endpoints.notes: Invalidates the Redis/memory session. Idempotent: an unknown/expired token still returns 200.

endpoints.name: departmentOptions
endpoints.notes: Public option list for the signup / department-selector dropdown.

endpoints.name: me
endpoints.notes: Alias of /core-webui/session with the same bootstrap shape.

endpoints.name: session
endpoints.notes: Active-only bootstrap; a pending/disabled session is 403 here — call sessionStatus instead.

endpoints.name: sessionStatus
endpoints.notes: Resolves for any valid session and reports status so the UI can render the approval-waiting screen. 401 for an expired/invalid session.

endpoints.name: selectDepartment
endpoints.notes: Validates department membership and returns the chat/context/resource routes. Non-member -> 403, unknown department -> 400.

endpoints.name: chat
endpoints.notes: Route obtained from department_routes[].chat_route in the session bootstrap.
